heading: Raised Access Floor
bottomHtml:
Data Center Access Flooring for Cooling & Cable Management

Raised access flooring in data centers plays a critical role in efficient underfloor air distribution and structured cable management. These systems feature heavy-duty panels supported by adjustable steel pedestals, allowing for flexible deployment of power, fiber, and HVAC components. Designed to meet the high-load demands of servers and network equipment, raised floors ensure optimal performance and energy savings in high-density computing environments.
